body:
Implemented a change on [fix/r25-routing-levels-wait](https://github.com/skygunner/magpie/tree/fix/r25-routing-levels-wait), head `f74765fd4901221b022c275f6bb6dfac76e4a50b` (one commit above `19253f67bca2310c32739a6eaac88546b3574dbc`).

In `internal/gui/assets/plugins/routing/client.js`, Save with Named levels and no selected level previously reported the refusal only through `status()`. In `internal/gui/assets/app.js`, that status text clears after 3.5 seconds. That gives the existing wait a transient result to observe. This branch keeps the same refusal beside the levels until the selection is corrected, and the existing Chromium/WebKit, English/Chinese test now asserts that the open editor contains it. The status pill is still shown.

Evidence for the new assertion in `routing-levels.test.cjs`, `a group names the reasoning levels agents are offered`:

- Clean base archive with only the changed test copied in: 4 tests, 0 pass, 4 fail, exit 1. Each fails with `AssertionError: the reason is under the levels, not only in the pill`.
- Pushed head: the same 4 tests pass, exit 0.
- `GOTOOLCHAIN=go1.26.8 go test -count=1 -tags nogui ./internal/gui` passes. Formatting is clean; vet, default build, Linux nogui build and Windows amd64 build each exit 0.
- The wider routing plus i18n run is **red**: 1422 tests, 1368 pass, 54 fail. Base comparisons record 20/20 failures in rule-remove and 44/168 in the other initial comparison files; targeted comparisons also reproduce rule-effort and intent/live-patch failures. This does **not** establish that every wider-suite failure is pre-existing: seven recorded failure blocks still lack a matching base failure. A later head subset ran 39 tests with 12 failures, and its WebKit subset passed 26/26. I am not claiming a green wider suite.

Not tried/proven: I did not directly reproduce the issue's original intermittent timeout at load 23–34. The red/green result proves the new persistent editor message, not the exact historical timeout mechanism. The full repository Go test suite, every GUI file, native Windows execution and native WebKitGTK were not run. The seven unmatched wider-suite failure records remain an acceptance gap. Please keep the issue open pending that verification.
